---
title: "An empty page open-graph entry with a preview image gets no size"
open-graph:
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image:height"'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width"'
---

![A square](square.svg){.preview-image}

The page declares `open-graph:` with no value, so it declares no size for its preview image, and the size the site declares for its own image is not used either.
